status_effects.explanation: Her polished, commanding performance of wit and physical grace gives her clear rhetorical dominance over the scene, in contrast to the princess's struggle to follow.

appraisal_events.evidence: en ralentissant son débit pour mettre encore mieux en relief les mots qu'elle avait l'air de modeler avec la moue de ses belles lèvres, le fuselage de ses longues mains expressives, et tout en attachant sur la princesse un regard doux, fixe et profond
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator lingers appreciatively on the duchesse's studied elegance of speech and gesture as she commands the room with her storytelling, though the description's emphasis on staged artifice keeps the admiration mildly self-aware.
